entries.en: to sell; to vend
entries.notes: 官话栏仅记"log."，系不明缩写或残留记号；"卖"义由西语Vender、汉字賣、音写bey三栏互证。

entries.en: to sell wine; to retail wine
to sell (literary register)
entries.notes: 西语词头azot/azol与汉字鬻均带[疑]，据卖字词族语境与音写by（近賣）取"卖"义。

entries.zh: 按吩咐/定好的价钱出售；执价
entries.en: to sell at the price prescribed (ordered)
to sell together; to sell in one lot

entries.zh: 搭配混卖；大小好歹掺在一起卖
entries.en: to sell mixed together in one bargain (small with large)
entries.notes: 词头connrato/contrato与汉字拕/抬均[疑]，据por juntos与音写sio…bey取"掺合搭卖"义。

entries.zh: 按喊定/强定的价钱卖（赶人价）
entries.en: to sell at a fixed or shouted price (forced price)
entries.notes: 词头convanda与首字赶/趪均[疑]，音写san lang gue读"赶人价"，取"按定/喊价出卖"义。

entries.zh: 照价卖；按所开/所标的价钱出售
entries.en: to sell at the asking (posted) price
entries.notes: 音写尾段buy cheng gue al/usn[疑]疑系跨栏混入，取首段"照价 chiau gue"定"按开价卖"义。

entries.zh: 按公道价卖；照公平价出售
entries.en: to sell at a fair (just) price
entries.notes: 汉字栏空白且音写含[疑]；据西语precio justo与音写cheng gue（近正价）定"公道价"义。

entries.zh: 毒；毒药、毒汁（汉字作"盘"，承"盘毒"之义）
entries.en: poison and venom
entries.notes: 词头Veneno/ponzoña、汉字、音写coi/cou均带[疑]，取"毒"义承下条盘毒=(Veneno)。

entries.en: poison
entries.notes: 音写首音cou/coũ有[疑]；盘毒对Veneno明确，zoḥ带入声合"毒"字。

entries.zh: 崇敬；敬奉（天主教语境敬礼天主、圣人、圣像）
entries.en: to venerate; to revere
entries.notes: 汉字栏空白，音写chim gung[疑]似"钦恭/尊崇"，按Venerar定"崇敬"义。

entries.en: to take revenge; to bear enmity (make enemies)
entries.notes: 西语栏含T99涂销不可辨字（trabar enemistad据残字推断），按"相冤家"取"结仇报复"义。

entries.en: to take revenge; to avenge a wrong
to take revenge
to repay wrong with wrong (feud for feud)

entries.zh: 衔结；报偿（汉字"衔结"多指结草衔环之报恩，与词头疑读之"报怨/报复"义相左，存疑）
entries.en: repayment, of kindness (gratitude) or of enmity (revenge); undetermined
entries.notes: 词头Vengatio/Vengativo、汉字衔/御、音写切分三处[疑]；报恩与报复两读语义相左，无法定夺。

entries.en: to come
entries.notes: 官话栏"mo"与"来"音不合，疑串行残留；来义由西语Venir、汉字来、音写lay三栏互证。

entries.en: an unexpected guest (one who arrives suddenly)

entries.zh: 最后来；落在末尾才来（尾手来）
entries.en: to come last
